result.question: Where does the man of God go after the lie?

readings.support: went back with him, ate bread in his house

assessments.reason: The passage says, “the man of God went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water,” so going “to his house” (the old prophet’s) matches the return destination implied by the key’s “Back to eat and drink.”
